array.name: loading_phrases
array.item: Always look for checks, captures and attacks.
The Sicilian Defense is the most popular response to 1.e4.
Develop pieces from their starting squares to gain control of the board.
Bringing your queen out too early can lead to opening blunders.
Look for pawn moves which allow you to develop your pieces.
Moving the same piece twice in the opening is generally considered a waste of tempo.
The evaluation graph calculates player advantage after each move.
A Blunder %Blunder% is a move which significantly impacts a player’s position in a negative way.
A Miss %Miss% is when a tactical opportunity or chance to punish your opponent\'s mistake is overlooked.
A Mistake %Mistake% is a bad move that immediately worsens your position.
An Inaccuracy %Inaccuracy% is a weak move which isn’t as good as the best move.
A Book %Book% move is a standard opening move regularly played by good players.
A Good %Good% move is fine, but also there were better moves on the board!
An Excellent %Excellent% move is essentially as good as the Best move: be proud!
The Best %Best% move is what the analysis engine determined was the top move.
A Great move %Great% is a critical move which altered the course of the game.
A Brilliant move %Brilliant% is when you find a great sacrifice.
Accuracy is a measurement of how closely you played to the Best %Best% moves.
Playing against Coach on the Computer page can help you think and improve.
Learning a new opening is a fun way of keeping chess fresh.
After 3 moves there are 121 million possible positions.
Some believe the Greek Gift Sacrifice was named after Gioachino Greco, who was Italian.
Stanley Kubrick hustled chess in Washington Square Park to pay for food in his early 20s.
There are nearly 1,800 grandmasters in the world.
En passant is French for in passing.
If rook comes from the Persian word rukh meaning chariot, why does the piece look like a tower?
Abhimanyu Mishra became the youngest grandmaster ever at the age of 12 years, 4 months, and 25 days.
The name Deep Blue came from a naming contest held by IBM and is a play on their nickname Big Blue.
Zugzwang is German for compulsion to move and happens when any move made puts the player at a disadvantage.
The chess game played in Blade Runner is a recreation of the Immortal Game between Adolf Anderssen and Lionel Kiseritzky in 1851.
There are 960 legal starting positions in a game of Chess960.
English chess masters were recruited as code breakers during World War II.
Until the mid-1800s, chess games were played without a time limit.
Until the 1600s, castling required two moves.
The current format for writing chess moves down, algebraic notation, was formalized in 1981.
The first chess computer, The Mechanical Turk, was actually just a guy hiding in a box pretending to be an automaton.
The last time checkmate happened in a World Championship match was 1929.
In 1951, IM Robert Wade played a simultaneous exhibition against 30 Russian schoolboys. Wade won 0 games, drew 10, and lost the other 20.
The quickest checkmate possible is only 2 moves.
World Champion Alexander Alekhine had a cat named Chess.
During the 1978 World Championship, Anatoly Karpov hired a hypnotist to sit in the front row and stare at his opponent.
World Champion Mikhail Tal only had 3 fingers on his right hand.
The Evans Gambit is named after 19th Century Welsh sea captain William Davies Evans.
The 1984–85 World Championship was abandoned after 5 months and 48 games for the health of the players.
The longest chess game in the history of the World Championship was game 6 of the 2021 World Championship, at 136 moves.
The blunders are all there on the board, waiting to be made. - Savielly Tartakower
There are two types of sacrifices: Correct ones, and mine. - Mikhail Tal
Chess is the gymnasium of the mind. - Blaise Pascal
Even a poor plan is better than no plan at all. - Mikhail Chigorin
The winner of the game is the player who makes the next to last mistake. - Savielly Tartakower
I am Alekhine, chess champion of the world. I have a cat called Chess. - Alexander Alekhine, when stopped at the Polish-Russian border without a passport.
Chess problems demand from the composer the same virtues that characterize all worthwhile art. - Vladimir Nabokov
Chess is a matter of delicate judgment, knowing when to punch and how to duck. - Bobby Fischer
Steady effort pays off, even if not always in an immediate, tangible way. - Garry Kasparov
A passed pawn increases in strength as the number of pieces on the board diminishes. - Jose Raul Capablanca
Chess is the art which expresses the science of logic. - Mikhail Botvninnik
If revenge motivates you, go for it! - Viswanathan Anand
If you want to play well, it\'s important to concentrate on the now. - Vassily Ivanchuk
The biggest challenge is to fulfill your own ideas about yourself - Judit Polgar
